title: 3 Idiots
short_description: Three friends navigate college life, friendship, love and their dreams.
description: 3 Idiots is a comedy-drama film about three engineering students and their experiences at university.

title: Mission: Impossible
short_description: Mission: Impossible is an American series of action spy films, based on the 1966 television series created by Bruce Geller.
description: Mission: Impossible is an American series of action spy films, based on the 1966 television series created by Bruce Geller.

title: Forrest Gump
short_description: A kind-hearted man experiences extraordinary events throughout his life.
description: Forrest Gump follows the remarkable life of a simple and kind man who unexpectedly becomes part of major moments in American history.

title: Inception
short_description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and attempts an impossible mission.
description: Inception is a science fiction thriller about a professional who infiltrates dreams and is given the task of planting an idea instead of stealing one.

title: The Dark Knight
short_description: Batman faces a criminal mastermind who throws Gotham City into chaos.
description: The Dark Knight follows Batman as he battles the Joker, a dangerous criminal who challenges the hero and the city he protects.

title: Titanic
short_description: A young couple from different social backgrounds falls in love aboard the Titanic.
description: Titanic tells the tragic love story of Jack and Rose, who meet aboard the famous ship during its first and final voyage.

title: La La Land
short_description: An aspiring actress and a jazz musician fall in love while pursuing their dreams in Los Angeles.
description: La La Land follows two ambitious artists as they struggle to balance their relationship with their dreams of success.

title: The Matrix
short_description: A computer hacker discovers that reality is not what it seems.
description: The Matrix follows Neo, a hacker who discovers that humanity is trapped inside a simulated reality and joins a rebellion against the machines.

title: John Wick
short_description: A retired assassin returns to his violent past after a devastating loss.
description: John Wick follows a legendary assassin who comes out of retirement and takes on a dangerous criminal organization.

title: Parasite
short_description: A struggling family becomes involved with a wealthy household in an unexpected way.
description: Parasite is a dark comedy thriller that explores class differences through the relationship between two very different families.

title: Spider-Man
short_description: After being bitten by a genetically modified spider, a shy teenager gains spider-like abilities and fights crime in New York City.
description: After being bitten by a genetically modified spider, ordinary teenager Peter Parker transforms into a web-slinging superhero. Driven by the tragic death of his uncle, he vows to use his extraordinary powers to protect New York City from the villainous Green Goblin.
